risk_if_not_implemented: Without Media Storage, sensitive and/or regulated data may be disclosed, altered or lost through inadequate classification, handling or protection. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Access (R-AC-4), Loss, Theft or Damage of Assets (R-AM-1), Unauthorized Retention / Inability to Dispose of Data (R-AM-3), Loss of Confidentiality (R-IP-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to natural threats NT-2, NT-3, NT-4, NT-5, NT-6, NT-8, NT-11, NT-12, NT-13, NT-14; Physical Crime (MT-5), Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Physical & Environmental Protections
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the operation of physical and environmental protection controls.
compensating_control_1.justification: Physical & Environmental Protections (PES-02) provides physical access control that compensates for the absence of Media Storage (DCH-13) by preventing unauthorized physical interaction with systems and infrastructure. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Encrypting Data At Rest
compensating_control_2.description: Cryptographic mechanisms exist to prevent the unauthorized disclosure of data at rest.
compensating_control_2.justification: Encrypting Data At Rest (CRY-07) provides cryptographic protection that compensates for the absence of Media Storage (DCH-13) by ensuring data confidentiality and integrity through alternative technical means. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
